The '''ankou''' is a [[monster]] that drops [[ankou residue]]. It can be spawned by using the [[ankou agitator]] on ten [[ankou]] that are out of [[combat]]. Ankou residue is required to complete a [[Kili's Knowledge IV]] task.

Ankou can be found in the [[Stronghold of Security]] and [[Wilderness Crater]].

Despite regular ankous counting towards [[Ankou (Slayer assignment)|ankou]], [[Ghosts (Slayer assignment)|ghosts]], [[Skeletons (Slayer assignment)|skeletons]], and [[Undead (Slayer assignment)|undead Slayer assignments]], this ankou only counts as an ankou.
